name: Thorn Clawtip
description: Seat the stance deeper and set the claws wide so the full-meridian qi waits ready in both forearms.

name: Rumble Shred
description: Draw the claw through the target in time with a pulse of qi so the tips score evenly along the whole stroke.

name: Flaysprint
description: Flow forward past the opponent's extended arm and settle the feet where both claws can strike his far side.

name: Gust Backplate
description: Brush the tines along an incoming forearm and let the qi in them throw the blow wide of the body.

name: Hoarfrost Clawrake
description: Keep the tines sunk in the opponent's guard arm and feed qi evenly so the hooks stay set against his pull.

name: Sanguine Raze
description: Send a wave of qi along the blade edge as the rake falls so the cut runs longer than the stroke itself.

name: Mayhem Knucklespike
description: Hook the guarding wrist from beneath and wrench it outward with qi until the opponent's chest stands open.

name: Gust Wristband
description: Rake with the full strength of qi in the arm so the tips score through plate or ribs and stagger the target.

name: Lot Hookclaw
description: Hook the guard open then rake and hook again in an unbroken chain so each stroke lands where the last one opened.

name: Fingerblade Plating
description: Settle the stance and let the qi field spread a finger's width beyond the claws so the guard has a margin.

name: Blaze Palmstrap
description: Draw the claw down so the field around the tips rakes the target a hand's breadth beyond the metal.

name: Granite Flay
description: Advance with the qi field brushing the floor ahead so each foot lands exactly where the field has measured.

name: Murkpawl
description: Spread the field over the front of the claw and turn a thrust aside before the metal is even touched.

name: Splitting Tinecurve
description: Narrow the field to a point ahead of the tines and prick through a gap in the opponent's guard.

name: Waningnail
description: Pass the claws slowly before the body and read from the field where the opponent's weight is about to shift.

name: Talon Cuirass
description: Cast the field out past the claw and hook the far sleeve with it then pull the opponent off balance.

name: Ripbarrage
description: Throw the rake high so the field clears the opponent's raised forearm and scores the brow behind it.

name: Rip Fastness
description: Close the field around the opponent's wrist and twist it sharply so the grip on his weapon fails.

name: Blazerip
description: Swing both claws so the joined field cuts a broad line that opens the opponent's guard and the shield behind it.

name: Charter Knucklespike
description: Press the field down over the opponent's arms through the claws so he cannot lift them while the tines hold.

name: Ponderous Backplate
description: Set the tines into a fold of cloth at the shoulder and test the hold before committing the pull.

name: Suppressing Hookclaw
description: Sink the tines through a hide jerkin and pull back so the armor drags the wearer after it.

name: Granite Clawbase
description: Rake across the seam of an elbow guard where the plates part and the tips can slip beneath.

name: Careening Clawbase
description: Step away on the hooked line so the opponent's own garment pulls him a stride behind the claw.

name: Might Scour
description: Pull the hooked claw back with a burst of qi and tear the straps that hold a shield or pack.

name: Crippling Talon
description: Hook behind the knee or elbow and wrench with qi until the joint buckles and the stance folds.

name: Gustnail
description: Hook a thick hide and tear it open in one drive of both claws so the flesh beneath is laid bare.

name: Lot Rip
description: Hook then tear then release the cloth in rapid turn so each pull sets up the next opening.

name: Thorn Fingerblade
description: Stand with the arms open and the field spread wide around the claws so the front is covered at a distance.

name: Iron Scour
description: Cut with the claws shaped so the field adds a hand's breadth of reach to the stroke beyond the tines.

name: Silt Shred
description: Slip forward as the field pushes the opponent's incoming blow aside and opens the line to his chest.

name: Unshaken Palmstrap
description: Check the opponent's reach with the field edge and parry the stroke before it can build force.

name: Remnant Wristband
description: Let the field rest against the opponent's guard and read from its pressure where his arm will move next.

name: Sanguine Clawtip
description: Brush the field-wrapped tines across the opponent's knuckles to open the skin without committing the arm.

name: Blazenail
description: Shape the field into a long curved blade over the claws and rake the opponent's far shoulder.

name: Ponderous Clawrake
description: Throw a hooked tongue of the field out and catch the opponent's wrist from beyond his reach.

name: Gouging Raze
description: Draw the field to a needle beyond the claw point and thrust it through the gap in a breastplate.

name: Rumble Clawtip
description: Burst the field against the opponent's forearm guard to knock it out of position and bare the ribs.

name: Ravaging Rumble Rip
description: Sweep both claws in a wide arc with the field extended so every foe within reach is cut at once.

name: Shredgreave
description: Spread the field over the opponent's weapon arm and pin it to his side from beyond arm's length.

name: Charter Hookclaw
description: Stand with the weight back and one claw forward like a hawk on its perch so the guard sits high and quiet.

name: Fingerblade Torment
description: Drop both claws together from above in parallel lines so the tips rake two furrows down the target.

name: Talonsprint
description: Step wide with both arms spread like wings and bring the feet together again on the opponent's flank.

name: Talon Cloak
description: Flick the wrist like a hawk turning in the air and knock a stroke aside with the claw's outer edge.

name: Gyve Flay
description: Hook the left claw on the opponent's guard arm and hold it level so the right claw has an open line.

name: Shredthrash
description: Strike with the right claw along the line the left hand has cleared and run qi to the tips on contact.

name: Rumble Backplate
description: Hook and pull in a curved line like a river bend so the opponent's strike is carried around and away.

name: Sanguine Clawbase
description: Hold the near wrist with one claw and rake the elbow with the other in one linked movement.

name: Lancing Tinecurve
description: Drop from a high guard onto the target like a stooping hawk and rake with both claws in one fall.

name: Dominating Clawrake
description: Sink both claws into the shoulder and the arm and lock them there with qi so the opponent is held.

name: Hoarfrost Tinecurve
description: Hold the claws apart and let a stream of qi run down each arm so two guards stand against the front.

name: Gustflay
description: Rake down a straight channel the way a river cuts its bed so the field follows the claw through the target.

name: Silt Scour
description: Cross one foot over the other like two currents meeting and come out on the opponent's blind side.

name: Unyielding Wristband
description: Part the claws as a stream parts around a stone and let the blow slip between them.

name: Fastening Raze
description: Hold one stream of qi steady in the left claw to keep its hook set while the right stream strikes.

name: Ironnail
description: Split the rake into two lines that part like a river fork and rejoin on the far side of the target.

name: Paralyzing Clawbase
description: Bring both claws onto one wrist from opposite sides and turn them together so the joint and grip give way.

name: Ripassault
description: Drive both streams of qi through the claws at once and tear the guard open from two directions.

name: Paralyzing Palmstrap Fastness
description: Pour both streams down onto the opponent's arms through the tines until they sag and cannot rise.

name: Pawlcloak
description: Hold the lead claw high on the guarding track and the rear claw low on the striking track at once.

name: Gustshred
description: Draw the rear claw along the striking track across the target while the guarding hand stays still.

name: Torrent Knucklespike
description: Step shoulder first like a hawk dipping a wing and let the claws follow into the opening.

name: Chimetalon
description: Cross the two claws at the wrist so the guarding track takes the blow and the striking track stays free.

name: Veritytalon
description: Watch the opponent's shoulders as a hawk watches the ground and read which hand will lead.

name: Iron Flay
description: Rake with one hand and then the other along the same line so the second cut deepens the first.

name: Toxin Wristband
description: Swap the guarding and striking roles in mid-motion and hook the opponent's wrist as he commits.

name: Novascour
description: Stab the tines forward with the hawk hand and pierce through the gap between the guard and the ribs.

name: Fastening Hookclaw
description: Bind the opponent's weapon arm with the guarding claw while the striking claw stays clear to cut.

name: Tearing Shred
description: Pour a quick flurry of short slashes along the striking track before the opponent can answer the first.

name: Talontorment
description: Hold the guard with one claw and rend the target with the other so defense and attack run together.

name: Knucklespike Maelstrom
description: Chain a guard a hook and a rake in turn so each track hands the opponent to the other.

name: Unshaken Tinecurve
description: Plant the feet as if sworn to the spot and hold the claws steady while the wind pushes at the back.

name: Nailbarrage
description: Draw the claw back through the target on the breath of the wind so the stroke comes light and ends hard.

name: Gust Fingerblade
description: Lean into the wind and let it carry the lead foot forward into the opponent's space.

name: Enduring Backplate
description: Brush the claw across the blow like a gust across grass and bend its line off the body.

name: Thornpawl
description: Hook the opponent's arm and hold it as an oath is held never loosening until the hook is released by choice.

name: Toxin Clawrake
description: Twist the hooked wrist in a sudden gale of qi that tears the grip from whatever the opponent holds.

name: Flaytorment
description: Rake with the whole force of a gale behind the claw so the tips split guard and plate alike.

name: Scour Hauberk
description: Sink both claws into the opponent's arm and hold them fast against his struggle until the fight is decided.

name: Granite Clawtip
description: Stand on the balls of the feet as if at the edge of a high plateau with the claws forward and the field wide.

name: Fortifying Palmstrap
description: Take a bearing on the opponent's chest in a single glance and carry it unchanged through every stroke.

name: Harpooning Flay
description: Rake along the line of the bearing already taken so the stroke needs no correction in flight.

name: Torrent Raze
description: Step across the line of the opponent's advance as a crosswind crosses a path and keep the bearing.

name: Unshaken Clawbase
description: Meet the stroke with a sideways sweep of the claw as the wind meets a bird and turn it past.

name: Subduing Shred
description: Hook the sleeve and pull along the held bearing so the opponent comes onto the claw and not around it.

name: Tempered Rip
description: Throw the rake out long on a breath of wind and score the far arm before the opponent reads the reach.

name: Boring Palmstrap
description: Thrust the tines forward as thin as a needle of wind and pierce the gap between two plates.

name: Iron Talon
description: Swing the claws through the opponent in a rending arc driven by the full force of the plateau wind.

name: Shade Knucklespike
description: Lock the claws on the opponent along the held bearing and press down until he can neither advance nor withdraw.

name: Talonplating
description: Stand square to the wind with the claws forward and nothing at the back to lean on.

name: Furrowing Talon
description: Rake with the wind at the back so the stroke carries a push that the arm alone could not give.

name: Mightrip
description: Step only forward and never back so the fight is carried to the opponent along one unbroken line.

name: Gust Hookclaw
description: Sweep both claws across the front in one wide gust to knock aside a low or a high attack.

name: Stifling Clawrake
description: Snag the opponent's sleeve with a flick of the hook and pull as the wind pushes from behind.

name: Flayassault
description: Slash wide across the opponent's body in the open as one would cut across a bare plateau.

name: Blaze Wristband
description: Dash past the opponent on a gust and rake his side as he turns to follow.

name: Suppressing Rip
description: Hook the arm from the windward side and wrench it downwind so the opponent's balance goes with it.

name: Gyve Clawtip
description: Close the hooked grip on the wrist and hold it fast whatever the opponent does to break away.

name: Tempered Tinecurve
description: Pull the sunk hooks back with a gale of qi and tear open the arm or armor they hold.

name: Alternating Fingerblade
description: Chain hook snag wrench and pull together in the open wind so each link tightens the one before.
